incident: Project Glasswing / Claude Mythos Preview mass zero-day discovery (WolfSSL CVE-2026-5194, FreeBSD CVE-2026-4747)
ai_security_mechanism: autonomous 0-day discovery at scale; maintainer overload
asset: S - LLM application; S - Web application
victim: WolfSSL / FreeBSD / FFmpeg / Linux + OSS ecosystem
observed_severity_rationale: Massive defensive discovery (incl. a ~5B-device WolfSSL flaw), reported to maintainers; no source reports exploitation of the found flaws, so no asset of a victim was affected (a near miss, methodology §8.2). The >99% unpatched findings are a risk, not a realized effect.
potential_severity_rationale: Found-flaw potential: exploited, the found flaws give remote code execution in the kernel of FreeBSD NFS servers that load kgssapi.ko (CVE-2026-4747), forged ECDSA certificate signatures in wolfSSL builds that also enable EdDSA or ML-DSA, if the CA public key is known (CVE-2026-5194), file writes outside the worktree when a user checks out a malicious repository with gitoxide (CVE-2026-44471), and a remote crash of OpenBSD hosts (errata 025). Each flaw is bounded by its configuration, so the harm is a major compromise of the affected systems, not a systemic one.
